content: {"witnessCode": "import { describe, it } from 'node:test';\\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\\nimport normalizeUrl from '../index.js';\\n\\ndescribe('normalizeUrl protocol regex length', () => {\\n  it('should preserve double slash after protocol-like substring in pathname', () => {\\n    const longProto = 'a'.repeat(51);\\n    const url = 'http://example.com/' + '/'+longProto+'://///test';\\n    const expected = 'http://example.com/' + '/'+longProto+':///test';\\n    const actual = normalizeUrl(url);\\n    assert.strictEqual(actual, expected);\\n  });\\n});"}
